title: For You
description: A phone feed of five short lyric edits, each in a look from the reference board: a blooming justified block over Times Square at night, a poem smearing in on black, electric-blue pixel type decaying line by line, a newsprint strip glued onto a halftoned sky, and white crayon capitals boiling on blue paper. Swipe or scroll to snap between them, double-tap to drop a heart.
intent: A real vertical feed with snap physics where every post is a finished lyric edit, so the reference board's styles play as the content of a believable app.
